assessment_summary: The proof relies on an inversion formula (Theorem 1) which is exactly correct, as are all the explicit calculations such as the numerical example in Section 2 (Lemma 2 and Cramer's rule matrix inversion) and the evaluation of contour integrals and residues in Section 4. The only potential issue is the invocation of a highly non-trivial asymptotic bound from Koukoulopoulos (Line 551) without a full unconditional proof, but this is a high-level theoretical claim for which a concrete counterexample with explicit numbers cannot be constructed. After honest effort, all concrete claims and formulas (matrix entries, residues, integral evaluations, and identities) are verified to be perfectly valid.
